caribbean.headline: Caribbean Storm Hits Martinique
caribbean.paragraph: Martinique is experiencing 100% rain probability with winds of 13 kt and wave heights of 2.6 ft, while Antigua is seeing winds of 17 kt with a less than 10% rain probability is not applicable as Antigua's data is not provided, however, the focus remains on Martinique. I am monitoring the situation closely as the Eastern Caribbean is also affected, with Antigua being the runner-up in terms of impact.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Istanbul
mediterranean.paragraph: Istanbul in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 14 kt and seas building to 2.5 ft with N swell at 4s periods. 50% rain probability -- isolated showers possible but conditions remain manageable.
